title: Evidence
description: Source-backed support or attack item for claims.

id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence item.

run_id.description: Reference to the run this evidence belongs to.

source_ref.description: Reference URL or path to the source, or null if not applicable.

summary.description: Brief summary of the evidence content.

full_text.description: Full text of the evidence, or null if not available.

reliability_score.description: Overall reliability score of this evidence (0-1).

source_authority.description: Authority score of the source (0-1), or null if not assessed.

recency.description: Recency score of the evidence (0-1), or null if not assessed.

specificity.description: Specificity score of the evidence (0-1), or null if not assessed.

independence.description: Independence score of the evidence source (0-1), or null if not assessed.

retrieval_confidence.description: Confidence in the retrieval process (0-1), or null if not assessed.

chunk_id.description: ID of the specific chunk retrieved, or null.

document_id.description: ID of the source document, or null.

supports_claim_ids.description: List of claim IDs that this evidence supports.

attacks_claim_ids.description: List of claim IDs that this evidence attacks.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata associated with this evidence.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this evidence was created.
